newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent pushed towards resistance in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent pushed towards resistance in thin volume.

text.p: IPE May Brent crude futures pushed higher ahead of the NYMEX open in an effort to drag the spot contract back above $20.00 after the April expiry on Friday.
"There's an effort to push the front month back to $20.00, but it's not very enthusiastic, volumes are very thin," said one.
May Brent was trading at a session high of $19.97 a barrel at 1418 GMT. Resistance was pegged at $20.02-$20.07.
Dealers said the emergence of modest buying was not sparked by any fundamental news.
April gas oil was trading $3.25 a tonne up at $172.75, just 25 cents off the intra-day high.
Prospects of colder weather in the United States were the main market prop, dealers said.
Independent forecasters Weather Services Corp said on Monday that colder air was expected to move into the Eastern United States by the middle of the week.
